gen-mystery-quest-gf-funnel-sans: Mystery Quest leaves every curve gaping open, with compact ascenders over tall lowercase, while Funnel Sans keeps its lines steady. Paragraphs slide past with hardly a snag in the rhythm.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-geist: Mystery Quest brings bookish, nostalgic charm, its curves open and its ascenders tucked low over tall lowercase. Geist keeps a quiet, level beat, its words landing as solid blocks.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-hind-mysuru: Nostalgic and bookish, Mystery Quest opens every curved stroke wide. Hind Mysuru draws a ballpoint's pressure-free line, its lowercase pressed close to ascender height, so text moves along briskly.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca reads like an unshaded line that never swells, with terminals that stop short of curling back in. Mystery Quest supplies the bookish, nostalgic heading, its curves gaping wide open.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-martel-sans: Open jaws on every curved stroke give Mystery Quest a bookish, nostalgic face, with compact ascenders over tall lowercase. Martel Sans keeps a high mean line, so words glide along easily.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-matangi: Mystery Quest opens every curved stroke wide, bookish and nostalgic. Matangi adds hefty, twine-like strokes and open rounds, its y tail matching its arm, so the two feel sturdy together.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-nata-sans: Old-library charm, nostalgic and bookish, with every curve left open. Mystery Quest does display flair best, while Nata Sans, with its technical-pen steadiness and slim joins, handles the running text.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-nobile: Mystery Quest arrives bookish and nostalgic, its curves wide open. Nobile moves along smoothly, its capitals nearly level with lowercase and its letter mouths left open like chalk arcs.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Bookish and nostalgic, Mystery Quest makes every curve gape open. It excels at display character, while Noto Kufi Arabic is the modern, clean workhorse with capitals just above lowercase.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unj: Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined reads modern, with generous space at curve ends. Mystery Quest does the bookish, nostalgic display work best, while the body font keeps cases close in height.
